role: The in-game HUD drawn over the world frame: vignette, pumpkin blur, portal swirl, hotbar, armour/health/food/air bars, boss bar, held-item name, the achievement toast, plus the chat and scoreboard handles.
scope_reason: The HUD is part of every gated frame; the native 2D overlay pass ports it.

members.name: recordPlaying
members.note: drawn only when !Oracle.cleanHud() (GuiIngame.java:333); cleanHud is true in PLAY and AGENT mode, the only modes the oracle runs (Main: --play or --agent), so no golden ever shows it. notes: The HUD inputs are the render-state dump's hud object recorded by RenderStateProbe; csrc/engine/hud_live.c rebuilds the same JSON for live frames so recorded and playable frames share raster_hud_draw. lane/idxclient: closed with checkable reasons: every hidden branch is behind Oracle.cleanHud() (PLAY or AGENT mode, every oracle run) or fancyGraphics (false in every oracle run's options). lane/idxclient (later): func_110327_a's prevHealth is 0 on the client player (only attackEntityFrom sets it, and EntityClientPlayerMP refuses it), and the hurt blink follows the client's hurtResistantTime as the S19, the tracker pass's health S1C (a plain watcher write) and then the S06 set it (idx-deathmsg-s1 101, 190, 279 at 0 px; cr-sweep-gold-g9-s42 700 from 11,071 px to 0). lane/idxclient (the audit's CL-01 and CL-02): the live client fills func_110327_a's styles from its own effects (poison, wither, regeneration's bob, hunger's food icons) and draws a ridden living's hearts in place of the food bar (its copy's health, a row behind as the S1C lands; hud_live.c writes mount, mhp2, mmax); the absorption row reads the client's own watcher 17, which the server's S1C now brings (PK_S1C_ABS). idx-hudfx2-s1 (a spider eye's poison, a golden apple's regeneration and absorption, rotten flesh's hunger, a saddled pig) within 19 to 215 px of scattered world pixels, no cluster. Wither's style is the poison branch's flag with another offset; no dev op gives the player wither (a wither skeleton's hit), so no recording draws it.
